title: regreSSHion: unauthenticated remote code execution in sshd
remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.8p1 or later, or install your distribution's patched package. Temporary mitigation: set LoginGraceTime 0 in sshd_config (this can allow connection exhaustion).

title: Path traversal and file disclosure in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49
remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or later. Ensure 'Require all denied' protects directories outside the document root.

title: Path traversal and remote code execution in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 and 2.4.50
remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or later. Disable mod_cgi if it is not needed.

title: vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor gives a root shell
remediation: Replace the binary with a vsftpd build from a trusted source and investigate the host for compromise. Prefer SFTP over FTP.

title: ProFTPD mod_copy allows unauthenticated file copy and code execution
remediation: Upgrade ProFTPD to 1.3.5a or later, or remove mod_copy from the configuration.

title: nginx resolver off-by-one memory overwrite
remediation: Upgrade nginx to 1.20.1 (stable) or 1.21.0 (mainline) or later. If the resolver directive is not needed, remove it.
